definition.LOPO: Descriptive sensitivity only; no parent/noise removed from the actual result
definition.aggregation: Two registered noises within each of eight parents, then parent-equal mean; ALL uses four noises per parent
definition.baseline: 64 saved cells verified and copied without any metric recomputation
definition.decision_scope: Descriptive necessary evidence only; no prior T/L/G A/B thresholds, no automatic promotion or default change
definition.half: One fixed full-parameter interpolation alpha=0.5; no training or alpha selection
definition.panels: OLD and FRESH separately; ALL is supplementary, not independent confirmation
definition.uncertainty: Original S/I bounds and E global bounds; NA retained. Exact same-condition same-source geometry cancels paired delta uncertainty only.
definition.useful_tradeoff: Positive S gain over START must be retained while historical CAPPED shape costs are reduced. Moving toward START alone is insufficient. Report each quality direction without a scalar total score.

ALL.scope: Necessary descriptive condition only; not sufficient for useful tradeoff, human usability or promotion

FRESH.scope: Necessary descriptive condition only; not sufficient for useful tradeoff, human usability or promotion

OLD.scope: Necessary descriptive condition only; not sufficient for useful tradeoff, human usability or promotion
